usedFor: Xero holds contacts, quotes, bills and payments, and Bolna places a call through “Make a Phone Call”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in Xero, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A fresh quote is a good moment to follow up, and the action places the call.

watchOut: “New Quote” in Xero is polling, so the call goes out after a scheduled check.
